reason: $147 a month is a lot when I'm under $5k a month and most of my leads come from posting and comment-to-DM anyway. Other Instagram DM tools cost a third of that, and I only do cold outreach when the pipeline is thin.
objection: It costs three or four times what other DM tools charge, there are no customer results yet, and it needs a card up front with payments final after day 3. I'd be paying for a tool that mostly helps in the weeks I'm not doing outreach.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $49 to $67 a month, or a free trial with no card, plus a few real results from agencies my size that show it booked calls.
